components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR) used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. On create/update it is accepted as a flat value for backward compatibility; when structured lines are supplied it is the composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^(\D*\d){10}\D*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, an 'ageBand' is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: Stable shared identifier for owners of the same household (same last name and address), assigned when 'sharesHousehold' is set.
          type: string
          example: '2f1b8c0e-0d3a-3b6e-9f4a-1c2d3e4f5a6b'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's title and last name, e.g. 'DR who'; just the last name when no title is given."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials, upper-cased and dot-separated, e.g. 'G.F.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', e.g. 'SMI-0007'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true

## Summary

Owner deletion is now a soft-delete. The changes, kept small and cohesive to minimize structural impact:

**Domain / persistence**
- `Owner.java` — added a `deleted` boolean column plus one-line `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted()` accessors.
- `db/hsqldb/schema.sql` — added `deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL` to the `owners` table (this is the profile the tests use; `ddl-auto=none`).
- `db/hsqldb/data.sql` — appended `FALSE` to the 10 seed owner rows (positional inserts). The h2 profile auto-adds the column via `ddl-auto=update`; postgres/mysql schemas are already stale relative to the entity and untested, so I left them untouched.

**API contract**
- `openapi.yml` — added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct auto-maps it. GET responses now carry `deleted`.

**Behavior**
- `OwnerRestControllerV1.deleteOwner` — instead of removing the row, it sets `deleted = true` and saves, still returning 2xx.
- `OwnerUniqueIdentityAdvice` — both create-side checks now skip soft-deleted owners: the identity-key loop gained a `!existing.isDeleted()` guard, and the household check filters deleted owners out before `Households.isDuplicate`. No new methods; each is a single-line change in the same file.

Verified:
- A new owner reports `deleted: false`; after DELETE, GET still returns the owner with `deleted: true`.
- A normally-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only matching owner has been soft-deleted.
